text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

CORN SALE - Taiwan's CK Group of importers Tuesday bought 54,000 tonnes of U.S. corn from Cargill at a tender. The corn was bought 87.99 U.S. cents over Chicago Board of Trade March futures. The shipment was slated for January 17-31 delivery U.S. Gulf or Feb 1-15 from Pacific Northwest.

- The Philippine-owned National Food Authority bought 150,000 tonnes U.S. yellow corn number two at an average price of $161.10 per tonne C&F. Shipment slated between November 9 and December 28 in six shipments.
WHEAT TENDER - A Philippine milling company has invited tenders for 10,000 tonnes dark northern spring and western white wheat for November shipment.
- Manila traders said on Tuesday another Philippine firm wanted to buy 16,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for November shipment.

WHEAT TENDER - Algeria on Monday launched a snap tender for a total of 100,000 tonnes of French and/or U.S. and/or Argentine soft wheat for shipment in the second half of December. It invited traders to submit bids on Monday with results expected at the earliest later in the day.

MARKET TALK - Five companies won six corn import contracts from the Philippines. Glencore Far East Philippines AG, a subsidiary of Glencore International AG, won two contracts of 25,000 tonnes of U.S. yellow corn No. 2 each at $159.98 per tonne, cash-and-freight (C&F), and $157.75 tonne C&F.

Continental Grain won a contract at $164.88 per tonne C&F with a delivery date of November 16. Louis Dreyfus won a contract at $165.39 per tonne C&F for Novemeber 23 delivery. Mitsui & Co Ltd won the fifth contract at $155.35 per tonne C&F. Delivery date is on December 14. Kanematsu won the sixth contract at $163.30 per tonne C&F.
WHEAT TENDER - Pakistan is seeking 200,000 tonnes of U.S. number two or better soft white wheat for Nov 12-30 delivery. Bids will be opened on November 3.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said on Wednesday it was extending until noon(1000 GMT) on November 6 the deadline for bids for 30,000 tonnes U.S. or Argentine yellow corn and 30,000 tonnes of soybean, any origin. The old deadline was October 30.
BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain Commission invited tenders by October 29 for 25,000 tonnes feed barley, for Nov 20-Dec 5 shipment from Europe or Nov 10-25 from North America.
... Cheaper Argentine wheat stands a better chance to be selected over other origins at a tender Algeria launched for 100,000 tonnes of optional wheat, traders said on Tuesday.

Algeria was still negotiating the purchase of the wheat, one day after launching a snap tender for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. and/or French and/or Argentine soft wheat for shipment in the second half of December, they said.

... Northrup King Co said that the Japanese Ministries of Agriculture, Food and Fisheries and of Health and Wellness have granted full approval to import Northrup King's Bt corn, as well as six other biotechnology crops.
